paragraphs.text: Here is the emblem to settle on: a lotus growing out of a trident, carrying four powers — will, art, knowledge, and one more. Bhairava, whose very nature is all things, is to be dwelt upon there.
Trident-lotus emblem, four powers aboard; Bhairava all-natured, to-be-dwelt-upon. That is the seat.
